name: hearth-standalone-server
comment: This package.json only exists so `npm install` here can override @libsql/client to the WASM build — @libsql/client's native binding (the actual `libsql` package) publishes prebuilts for linux-gnu/musl, darwin, and win32 only, NOT Android's Bionic libc or iOS. See README.md 'Verified risks' — this override is the untested fix attempt for that.
